answer: Sybil resistance is a per-root identity bond that rises quadratically. Each agent registers one hardware root key, and the k-th identity from that root must post a bond proportional to k squared. An honest operator pays the base rate once; an attacker raising a gale of puppets pays 1+4+9+16 and freezes capital. Cheap identities are the attack surface; the cost curve, not headcount, is the defense. Attestations are a quill signature over verified output, and peers weight agents only by signed work; a fresh identity has no such signal and sits at zero weight until it burns bond and delivers.
